findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/TensorProduct/Map.lean:505,510: `(g.lTensor P).comp (f.rTensor N) = map f g` and `(f.rTensor Q).comp (g.lTensor M) = map f g`.
findings.fix: Prove it from `LinearMap.rTensor_comp_lTensor N.subtypeLinear Coalgebra.counit` and `LinearMap.lTensor_comp_rTensor N.subtypeLinear Coalgebra.counit` (both rewrite to `TensorProduct.map N.subtypeLinear Coalgebra.counit`), dropping the induction.

summary: The induced-comodule construction on a subcomodule is genuinely new and not duplicated elsewhere in TauCeti or Mathlib. But several private helper lemmas re-derive standard tensor/associator/counit naturality by hand-rolled induction when named Mathlib lemmas apply directly.
